description: Operational simulation settings, discounting conventions, PSA sample sizes, mortality source, and model time unit.
reference: Project simulation protocol; these values control analysis execution rather than representing clinical observations.

environment.description: Execution mode and random seed. The fixed seed supports reproducible paired PSA iterations.

discounting.description: Annual discount rates and switch controlling whether discounting is applied.
discounting.reference: Existing project economic-evaluation assumptions; confirm against the health-economic guideline selected for the thesis jurisdiction.

psa.description: Numbers of probabilistic iterations used for development checks and production analysis.
psa.reference: Project computational design choice; production precision should be confirmed using Monte Carlo error or convergence diagnostics.

mortality.description: Selects the mortality input file used for background age-specific death rates.
mortality.reference: The selected Iran file records its own United Nations WPP provenance.

time.description: Number of weekly model cycles treated as one year.
